scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with 149 supplementary numerical assertions; no external independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Results apply to fixed-parameter diffusive weak-limit densities. The uniform two-scale estimate is restricted to quantum-update probability 0<q<=1/4; fixed-q far tails allow 0<q<1. No finite-time joint limit is derived. Potential implicit prior coverage by general uniform Gaussian-mixture asymptotics remains.
title: Two rare-displacement crossover scales for an interpolating quantum walk
